name: Being A Good Helper
overview: Scripture reveals that being a good helper involves trusting in God's faithful assistance and righteous support, as He promises to strengthen and uphold His people (Isaiah 41:10). Believers are called to reflect God's light to the world, serving as visible examples of His grace and peace (Matthew 5:14; Jeremiah 29:11). This role is rooted in the believer's identity as a child and heir of God through Christ, empowered by faith and righteousness (Galatians 4:7; Romans 3:22), while recognizing that God intimately knows the secrets of the heart (Psalms 44:21).
